up: Extract the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1875 (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 4). Each row must have: standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=' (exact value), and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. The target must be a human single-protein target (tax_id = 9606, target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'). Return these columns in each row: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the output by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the result to 1000 rows. Use the standard join paths: activities -> assays on assay_id, assays -> target_dictionary on tid, activities -> molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures on molregno.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type AS standard_type, activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1875' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
